_doc: CLOSED-LOOP-1 write-back: every lesson and decision as a row with a closing probe (file:<path> or grep:<path>::<regex>) that `python3 -m foundation orphans --check` executes on every PR and loop pass. Written by `python3 -m foundation writeback record --kind lesson|decision --probe SPEC`.

rows.title: CLOSED-LOOP-1: no artifact without a consuming loop, no wait on a person
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-12: assume nothing is read, reviewed or decided by a person. Policy values in doctrine/closed-loop.json and closed_loop in autonomy/policy.json; foundation/orphans.py fails CI on a new orphan artifact, a non-identity-bound wait or a failing ledger probe; lessons and decisions are ledger rows with probes, not pages.

rows.title: Write-back is an executable ledger row, not a page
rows.body: writeback record --kind lesson|decision writes doctrine/decision-ledger.json with a required file or grep probe; closedloop --check runs every probe.

rows.title: Orphan scan delegates to the document audit
rows.body: CLOSED-LOOP-1 (orphans.py) and DOC-CONSUMED-1 (docs_audit.py) measured the same thing two ways. The document audit is the single definition; orphans.py keeps the human-wait check, the decision ledger and the backlog issue, and reads orphan documents from docs_audit.

rows.title: Fleet skips archived repositories
rows.body: ultrastable/seed is archived and read-only; its live copy is the seed directory of this repository. The fleet lane lists live repositories only and records an archived one instead of failing or opening a card.

rows.title: Deploy was green while live served old code
rows.body: Merged site 0.3.1 never went live: worker.js imports ../seed/analytics/analytics.js, the single-file upload returned code 10021, deploy-site.mjs ignored success=false, and the verify step fetched only an image. Measured after the fix: curl https://ultrastable.io/health returned version 0.3.1 and /org returned 200 (before: 0.2.0 and 404). deploy-site now runs on push to main for site paths; deploy exits nonzero unless the live version equals the repo VERSION; lane no longer fails on the concurrent-merge race.

rows.title: Bootstrap settings script reported success while doing nothing
rows.body: apply_github_settings.sh printed failures: 0 with jq missing, so every step was a no-op; it also failed on CRLF jq output, targeted six archived repos, omitted workers/spec/license, and treated GitHub plan limits as permanent red. Measured after the fix: running it from an org-admin gh session returned 'failures: 0 gated: 8' and the org description matches the config. It now requires jq and gh, strips CR, skips archived repos and reports plan-gated features as GATED. Lane merges via GITHUB_TOKEN never fire push workflows, so the lane dispatches deploy-site after merging deployable paths, and scripts/drift_probe.sh compares live version and org description daily; measured: site live=0.3.1 repo=0.3.1.

rows.title: Code repo holds code; administration lives in ops; the front door is one prompt bar
rows.body: Measured: 27 of 44 open issues in ultrastable/ultrastable were administration (funding, patent, legal, owner cards, org setup) and were transferred to the private ultrastable/ops repo; 19 code tasks remain and are executor-owned. Site 0.4.0 adds /start, a single prompt bar that stores a plain-words idea in KV; node site/site.test.mjs passes with the page and the POST. Next, tracked in ops: executor reads its queue from repo data so Issues can be disabled on the code repo, the idea consumer asks follow-up questions and scaffolds a Cloudflare Worker, and the six archived duplicate repos are removed after a mirror backup.

rows.title: Six archived duplicate repos deleted after mirror backup
rows.body: Measured: gh repo list ultrastable now shows ultrastable, ops, license, spec, workers and .github only. Before deletion each of seed, platform, docs, site, business and ip was mirror-cloned (1 ref each, 87K to 515K) to repo-backups outside the repository; their content already lives in ultrastable/ultrastable.

rows.title: BUILD-1: the product is idea to live site in one prompt bar, no setup
rows.body: Measured: on ultrastable.io (site 0.5.0) a plain-words idea posted to /api/idea became a hosted page at /s/<id> in about 20 seconds using Workers AI and KV, with no account, key, repo or terminal; the change form regenerates it. node site/site.test.mjs covers idea, build, serve and change. Generated pages run under a sandbox CSP. Limits found: no shared back end yet (data stays in the visitor's browser), pages live on a path of ultrastable.io rather than their own address. Next: per-site database and wildcard subdomain, tracked in ultrastable/ops.

rows.title: USER-PATH-1: guided set-up is data, one yes/no question per screen, plain words only
rows.body: Measured: https://ultrastable.io/setup (site 0.6.0) walked in a real browser: yes to GitHub, typed a name, step 3 opened https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable/generate and showed the confirm screen; progress persisted in localStorage. The steps live in doctrine/user-path.json, site/userpath.js is generated, and scripts/gen_userpath.py --check (a step in checks) fails on technical words, non-https links or stale output. ultrastable/ultrastable is now a GitHub template so the Make my copy click works for anyone with access. Next in ultrastable/ops: first-run workflow in the copy that enables its own autopilot without a click, Cloudflare Deploy button once the seed is public, OAuth connections for Google and Buffer.

rows.title: The front door asks what it does not know and audits what it built
rows.body: Verified live on ultrastable.io (site 0.7.0): an idea produced 3 tap-only questions, the answers entered the build brief, the page was live in about 30 s, and an independent model (llama-3.3-70b, not the qwen builder) published /s/<id>/review listing 4 done, 5 gaps and the standing limits. Problems found by that run: a deprecated hard-coded model id had silently disabled the audit, so every AI call now walks a model list (re-probed, audit returns real findings); builds and audits run in separate requests because waitUntil is capped near 30 s; a stuck build now fails after 150 s. node site/site.test.mjs passes the whole flow. Pattern from QNFO prompted recall.

rows.title: Backgrounded AI build was evicted and left sites stuck at building
rows.body: Measured: a live POST to /api/idea returned a make URL that still showed Building after more than 2 minutes, while a direct Workers AI call for the same kind of page took 28 s. The build ran in waitUntil, which is cut off about 30 s after the response, so the state never left building. Fixed in site 0.5.1: the job is stored, the /make request awaits the build, a 120 s claim stops duplicate builds, an evicted build is resumed by the next poll, and tries are capped at 3 before the state becomes failed. node site/site.test.mjs covers the build, the change and the capped failure.

rows.title: COMPLETE-1: finished work and finished threads are closed automatically
rows.body: Standing owner rule written into agents/AGENTS.md, seed/agents/AGENTS.md and agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md. Verified by running scripts/completion_sweep.sh against the live repo: it deleted 2 squash-merged branches (agent/brand-settings-buildout, claude/project-thread-pi8gkc) and left every branch with unmerged commits or an open PR alone; gaplint reports 0 findings. The sweep runs in the daily lane workflow. Session side: the app already archives on PR close and after 1 idle day (probed with get_settings), and 5 idle finished sessions were archived. Next: sweep closes done issues with evidence and ops-repo threads.

rows.title: Work queue is repository data; Issues are turned off on the code repo
rows.body: Measured: python3 -m foundation queue --check prints queue ok with 26 takeable items, and 17 former GitHub issues were migrated to docs/issues/Q-*.json. The executor now picks from foundation/queue.py (EXECUTOR_SOURCE=issues restores the old source), claims nothing remotely, and closes the item inside its own pull request so the merge is the closure; three consecutive failures park an item. Issue scripts exit 0 when has_issues is false, funding findings become queue items, and tests/foundation/test_executor.py covers the queue.

rows.title: Executor picked queue items live but had no model route
rows.body: A dispatched executor run on main picked Q-10 from the repo-data queue and recorded no-model-credential, because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not bound in Actions; the issues sweep also failed on disabled Issues. Measured after the fix: pytest tests/foundation/test_executor.py returned 9 passed, and python3 -m foundation orphans --sync-issue returned 'issues off: backlog enforced by orphans --check in checks; zero=True'. Added a Workers AI model route using the Cloudflare secrets the repo already holds, and org settings now declare has_issues false so a settings apply cannot turn Issues back on.

rows.title: Executor PR sat as an unchecked draft
rows.body: The first live executor run opened PR 233 for Q-10 as a draft with zero checks, because a PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN raises no pull_request event and a draft runs no CI, so the lane had nothing to merge. Measured after the fix: python3 -m pytest tests/foundation/test_executor.py returned 9 passed and the executor now marks the PR ready and dispatches checks.yml on its branch right after pr create, recording any failed kick in the log row.

rows.title: BOUNDARY-1 containment boundary
rows.body: Creation and destruction inside a rebuildable boundary; egress gated; trust tiers apply inside only; session reaper; strange-loop improvement ledger.

rows.title: Boundary session reaper
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDtuoapfx2PcxBPEqWf. Finished or idle sessions are archived from boundary.reap decisions.

rows.title: FRONT-2 chat-thread front door
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDtuoapfx2PcxBPEqWf. The front door is a conversation: pill input with dictation, rotating context-aware suggestions (bank plus model), tap-to-answer questions in the thread, each build step shown as it runs, change requests in the same thread. JSON endpoints /api/suggest, /api/idea, /s/<id>/status. No-JS form fallback kept.

rows.title: MARKET-1 components and gaps as data
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDtuoapfx2PcxBPEqWf. doctrine/market.json holds components, researched competitor coverage with sources read 2026-11-12, users, stories and objections. Claimed features need passing proofs and tests; each gap is a Q-GAP queue item the executor works; competitor names stay off the public site. Defensible wording is 'not found in the sources read', never 'nobody does'.

rows.title: Write-back open-loop ids are max+1, never count+1
rows.body: count+1 overwrote OL-20261112-11 (the Cloudflare account transfer residual) because ids have gaps; closedloop --check caught it as a residual with no queue entry. record() now takes max+1 and refuses to overwrite.

rows.title: POSITION: say what Ultrastable is not for
rows.body: The home page lists what Ultrastable is not for (one-off pages, prompt-by-prompt vibe coding) and agent.md tells assistants to stop when the idea is a one-off page, so people self-select into ongoing systems that need setup and a paid back end.

rows.title: Server-side only: GitHub Actions on its built-in token is the credential-free route
rows.body: Owner directive 2026-11-12: Ultrastable runs server-side only. The scheduler host on a person's computer, its two launch scripts, the browser sign-in script and the desktop task definition were removed. The No-single-route rule stays; its credential-free route is now the GitHub Actions loop host, because GitHub mints the workflow token for each run and no person mints it (deploy/routes.json person_free_credentials). The failover chain is Cloudflare worker 0 h, cloud-hosted Claude routine 3 h, GitHub Actions 12 h behind a daily gate. Measured: python3 scripts/check_routes.py prints 'routes ok: credential-free route is server-side (github-actions)'; python3 -m foundation serverside --check prints 'serverside ok'.

rows.title: The lane workflow is the server-side needs-pat merger
rows.body: PRs that change .github/workflows are merged by scripts/lane.sh in lane.yml, on green and on the exact head commit, with a workflow-capable credential resolved by scripts/lane_credential.py: LANE_PAT, then a GitHub App installation token (LANE_APP_ID, LANE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY). PRs labeled hold are skipped. Measured on 2026-11-12: PR 222 changed lane.yml and its lane review was posted by github-actions[bot], so the lane ran on the built-in token and LANE_PAT was not bound then; with no credential the lane leaves such PRs open, green and labeled needs-pat and logs waiting=N. The owner step is the single item lane-credential in foundation/data/needs-you.json with that default in effect. Evidence: tests/foundation/test_lane_merger.py, 10 tests pass.

rows.title: Test helpers left a repository copy per test in the temp directory
rows.body: copy_repo() and tiny_repo() called tempfile.mkdtemp() and nothing removed the result. Measured on main before the fix: one run of python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/foundation left 113 directories and 781 MB in the temp directory; on the larger checkout three runs filled a 117 GB disk. Fix: tests/foundation/_repo.py scratch() registers removal with the running test (addCleanup, addClassCleanup), at interpreter exit, and sweeps directories a killed run left; every bare mkdtemp in tests/foundation goes through it and test_repo_cleanup.py fails a new bare one. Measured after the fix: the same run leaves 0 directories.

rows.title: Closing probes proved code existed, not that loops ran
rows.body: Every closing probe in the loop registry was file: or grep:, so loops verify passed while two workflows had never run. Measured 2026-11-12 12:58 UTC through the GitHub API: loop.yml 0 runs, fleet.yml 0 runs; executor log row 0.8 h old and session ledger row 0.5 h old on their evidence branches. Fix: foundation/liveness.py reads run evidence per probe in instances/ultrastable/liveness.json and gives alive, stale, failing, never or unknown; every launch pass runs it and files a queue item per loop that is not alive. Both workflows were dispatched on main at 12:59 UTC to start them.

rows.title: Tick loader resolved paths with URL.pathname
rows.body: platform/selfhost/tick.mjs and the GCP adapter built file paths from URL.pathname, which is percent-encoded and on Windows begins with a slash before the drive letter, so the migrations directory was looked up at a doubled drive path there and at dir%20with%20space on any host whose checkout path has a space. Measured before the fix on Linux: selfhost boot from a copy under 'dir with space' returned status failed, ENOENT scandir .../dir%20with%20space/seed/worker/migrations. Fix: fileURLToPath. Measured after: tests/foundation/test_selfhost.py test_full_tick_from_a_path_that_needs_url_decoding passes; the GCP adapter tests pass. The http metric source in seed/worker/src/tick.js had no test; seed/worker/test/measure.test.js now covers 2xx, error status, unreachable host and recovery.
